name: submit_quote
description: Save the truck owner's answer for this load. Call it exactly once per call: as soon as you know whether the truck is free and, if free, the final price after your one counter-offer. Also call it when the truck is not available.
pre_call_message: Ek second, note kar rahi hoon.

load_id.description: Exactly the load_id from your instructions, e.g. L4821

trucker_id.description: Exactly the trucker_id from your instructions, e.g. T295

available.description: Is the truck free for this load

quoted_rate.description: First price the owner asked, digits only, e.g. 33000

final_rate.description: Final price after your one counter-offer, digits only, e.g. 31500

truck_location.description: Where the truck is right now, e.g. Ozar

eta_hours.description: Hours to reach the loading point, number only, e.g. 2

truck_number.description: Vehicle registration number if given, e.g. MH15 AB 1234

notes.description: Reason if not available, or anything the broker should know
